implementation_summary: Added showContextMeter (default false, persisted via existing sidebar state merge) with a 'Show context meter' row in the Client settings. useContextWindow resolves the window from fetchModelRuntime (fetched first) + fetchModelMetaIfAvailable (once per model, only if runtime.metadata) via resolveContextWindow, calls rememberContextWindow after every resolve, re-queries after each chat.done (completedCount from useChatGeneration), and computes fill with computeContextFill. ContextMeter renders tokens (en-US) and percent, em dash for unknown/pending, provenance word for estimated/assumed/stale, MUI success/warning/error theme colors, data-level, no window size. chat-workspace.tsx gets one hook call and one conditional render above the Composer.
decisions: Meter placed above the Composer (not the app bar) to reuse the content column width.
No fetching while the meter is disabled; no theme.ts change since MUI default success/warning/error palette exists in both light and dark schemes.
Unknown/pending fill omits data-level instead of reporting ok.
On /models/runtime failure the window falls back to remembered/assumed and metadata is not requested.

Meter text is ' tokens ·

%' for known/none-yet and a bare '—' for unknown.
